displayName: David Nigerian English — Cinematic Documentary Voice
description: A warm, confident Nigerian English male voice for cinematic documentary narration, technology stories, business case studies and long-form social video. The speaker reference is David's own recorded narration sample — not a generic Nigerian voice.
characteristics: David's actual recorded voice as the speaker reference
Avoids overdramatic delivery unless the scene requires it

reference.consent: Recorded by the owner of this project. Explicit consent is granted for local voice cloning and for commercial narration in the owner's monetised social videos.

enginePreference.note: Only engines cleared for commercial narration are used by default. xtts_v2 is measured for quality comparison but its Coqui Public Model License restricts commercial use of the model weights.

licensing.referenceAudioLicense: Owned by the project owner; consent recorded in this profile.
licensing.generatedAudioUsage: Cleared for the owner's monetised social media videos subject to the selected engine's licence.
licensing.disclosure: Disclose synthetic narration where required by platform policy. Never present generated audio as a genuine recording of a real event or as someone else's voice.

notes: The original 48 kHz reference is never overwritten.
A 16-second clean clip is derived for engines whose voice prompt has a short context window.
The last 20 seconds of the original are held out from cloning and used only for objective similarity checks.
